confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from an RBA search result. It showed 0.6677 USD per AUD in a latest-rates table dated 19 November 2026, and 0.6720 as the 4 pm rate on 18 November. I used the 18 November 4 pm figure because the RBA overview page confirms it. Food and drink anchors rest on one search that returned a few Boracay menu prices in pesos (beer about P150, cocktails about P300, budget meals P65-150, mid-range about P350-550 per person) and a travel-cost estimate site. No cappuccino price was found, so coffee is an estimate. Wine is estimated from the beer price, as a glass priced above a cocktail in the Philippines. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, with no listings checked. They are the least certain, and July is rainy, shoulder-season pricing.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Philippine island resort destinations such as El Nido and Siargao, with tourist-area pricing above mainland Philippine cities.
